title: How Many Michelin Star Restaurants? By Country and State
description: How many Michelin star restaurants there are in every country and US state, with one-, two- and three-star counts, updated after every guide.
h1: Michelin Star Restaurants by Country and State
summary: How many starred restaurants every country and US state has, updated after each guide.

body:
There are {{total}} Michelin-starred restaurants in the world across {{countries}} countries and territories, counting the {{guideYear}} MICHELIN Guide editions. {{topCountry}} has the most, with {{topCountryN}}, ahead of {{secondCountry}} ({{secondCountryN}}). In the US, {{topState}} leads every state with {{topStateN}}.

This page counts every starred restaurant by country, then by US state, from the same restaurant list that powers The Starred Bill’s price pages. It is rebuilt whenever a new guide is published, so the numbers below are always the latest we have. For what the stars mean, start with What is a Michelin star?

Michelin star restaurants by country

Each row counts restaurants, not stars: a three-star restaurant counts once. Tap a country to see what dinner, lunch and wine pairings cost at every one of its starred restaurants.

{{table:countries}}

Europe dominates the list because the Guide began in France in 1900 and spread through Europe long before it reached the rest of the world. Japan is the big exception: the MICHELIN Guide has covered Tokyo since 2007, and it is one of the most starred cities on earth. Newer guides, from the Philippines to New Zealand, start with only a handful of stars, and the counts grow as inspectors cover more cities.

Michelin star restaurants by state

There are {{usTotal}} Michelin star restaurants in the USA, spread across {{usStates}} states and Washington DC, and {{n3us}} of them hold three stars. Michelin doesn’t cover the whole country: it publishes guides for particular states and regions, such as California, New York, Chicago, Washington DC, Florida, Texas, Colorado and the American South, so a state with no guide has no stars, however good its restaurants are.

{{table:us-states}}

{{topState}} ({{topStateN}}) and {{secondState}} ({{secondStateN}}) are far ahead of the rest. On its own, New York City has more starred restaurants than most countries. {{thirdState}} comes third with {{thirdStateN}}.

Countries with no Michelin Guide

Some of the world’s great food countries have no Michelin stars at all. That isn’t a verdict on their restaurants: Michelin only awards stars where it publishes a guide, and it chooses where to go, often in partnership with a national tourism board.

How many Michelin star restaurants are in India?

None yet. India has no MICHELIN Guide for restaurants, although Michelin has rated Indian hotels with its Keys since 2025. Reports in 2026 say the government is close to a deal to bring the restaurant guide to India, with stars expected to start in the biggest cities. Until that happens, chefs born in India hold stars only abroad, in cities such as London, New York and Bangkok; we profile them in Indian chefs with Michelin stars. Our guide to Michelin stars and India follows the plans, and we will add an India page as soon as the first stars are announced.

Are there any Michelin star restaurants in Australia?

No. Michelin has never published a guide for Australia, so the answer to how many Michelin star restaurants are in Australia is none: Sydney and Melbourne have no starred restaurants. Australian restaurants are rated instead by local guides, which award chef’s hats. Several Australian chefs run starred kitchens abroad. That is about to change: the first Australian guide, for South Australia, reveals its stars on 14 October 2026, as our guide to Michelin star restaurants in Australia explains.

How many Michelin star restaurants are in New Zealand?

New Zealand is the newest country on the map. Michelin published its first guide for New Zealand in June 2026, and the country now has {{in_new_zealand}} starred restaurants: {{split_new_zealand}}. See our New Zealand page for prices.

South Africa

South Africa has no MICHELIN Guide and no stars. Its restaurants are rated by local awards instead; our guide to Michelin star restaurants in South Africa explains why, and where the nearest stars are.

Check the MICHELIN Guide itself for the latest news; new guides are announced every year, and we add each new country here once its first stars are published.

Michelin star restaurants in Canada, the UK and Ireland

How many Michelin star restaurants are in Canada?

Canada has {{in_canada}} Michelin star restaurants ({{split_canada}}), in Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal and Quebec City, the areas the Canadian guides cover. See our Canada page for Michelin star restaurants in Canada city by city.

How many Michelin star restaurants are in the UK?

There are {{ukTotal}} Michelin star restaurants in the UK: {{split_uk}}. Of those, {{londonTotal}} are in London. Our UK page lists them all with prices, and 3 Michelin star restaurants in the UK covers the very top.

How many Michelin star restaurants are in Ireland?

Ireland has {{in_ireland}} starred restaurants ({{split_ireland}}), published in the MICHELIN Guide Great Britain & Ireland. See our Ireland page.

How the numbers change each year

Every guide is revised once a year, so these counts move with each ceremony (here are the Michelin Guide ceremony dates). New restaurants earn first stars, others go up or down a level, and some close. The biggest moves are at the top: in {{guideYear}} so far, {{new3}} restaurants reached three stars and {{lost3}} lost them.

{{table:three-star-changes}}

Each destination page on The Starred Bill marks recent gains and losses under Show › Recent star changes, and our list of every three-star restaurant is updated after each ceremony.

faq.q: Which country has the most Michelin stars?
faq.a: {{topCountry}}, with {{topCountryN}} starred restaurants, followed by {{secondCountry}} ({{secondCountryN}}) and {{thirdCountry}} ({{thirdCountryN}}). {{top3Country}} also has the most three-star restaurants, with {{top3N}}.

faq.q: Which US state has the most Michelin stars?
faq.a: {{topState}}, with {{topStateN}} starred restaurants, followed by {{secondState}} with {{secondStateN}}. Between them they hold most of the country’s two- and three-star restaurants.

faq.q: How many Michelin star restaurants are there in the US?
faq.a: {{usTotal}}, of which {{n3us}} hold three stars. They are spread across {{usStates}} states and Washington DC, the areas a current MICHELIN Guide covers.

faq.q: How many Michelin star restaurants are there in the world?
faq.a: {{total}}: {{n1}} with one star, {{n2}} with two and {{n3}} with three, across {{countries}} countries and territories.
